ValidationRule.description: This validation will fire if Maker is updating the checker result for Profile Update Project
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Personal Info Update"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Mobile update"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Email update"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Expired ID Update"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Name Fix / Update"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Address update"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Additional Information"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Guardian Info") ), ISCHANGED(cc_Checker_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Checker_Result__c, "")), (Address_Updated_By__c = $User.Id), ($User.LastName <> "Integration") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Maker cannot able to select Checker Result.
